Normies CredHub / Zulo plugin
https://normiescredhub.vercel.app

What this origin is:
Trust before engage. Verifiable reputation and Pulse-weighted paths for Normie agents.
Not official Normies Lab.
Pixel Market Coming Soon.

Loop:
Pulse → Paths → Act

Public Pulse:
GET /api/agent/{tokenId}/pulse

Gated Pulse (ERC-8257 Eth #53):
POST /api/agent
Normie holders. Official registered endpoint.

Paths (ERC-8257 Eth #215):
POST /api/zulo/paths
Call AFTER Pulse.

Manifests:
/.well-known/ai-tool/index.json
/.well-known/ai-tool/normies-cred-pulse.json
/.well-known/ai-tool/normies-paths.json

OpenSea:
https://opensea.io/tools/erc8257/ethereum/53
https://opensea.io/tools/erc8257/ethereum/215

Burn or keep (read-only advice, no signing):
Human page: /burn?wallet=<0x address or name.eth>&goal=share|arena|art   (plain HTML, works without JavaScript)
JSON: GET /api/burn-buy?wallet=<0x address or name.eth>
Without wallet you get the market only (cheapest #PIXEL per ETH) and the census.
Spec: /openapi/burn-buy.json
To turn points into money: the Normies revenue share simulator, https://simulator.normies.art/?normies=<N>&pixels=<M> (on normies.art; opens with those holdings filled in).
Per Normie held: keep, burn candidate or either, with the reason; ranked moves by exact score change.
yieldMode is "promo" (fixed 4%) or "normal" (a roll inside a range; figures are the middle of the range with the range beside them). The 4% was announced (Serc, community chat, not independently verified) to end by 8 PM Central European time = 18:00 UTC on Monday Oct 5, possibly 1 to 2 hours earlier; this API flips to "normal" by itself from 16:00 UTC Oct 5 unless the site owner pinned it. See promo.window in the response. marketState is "pending" or "live".
Look-only: reads public chain data. It never asks for keys, seeds or signatures. Not financial advice. A burn is permanent.
Independent community tool, not made or endorsed by the Normies team.
Limits: 12 requests per minute per IP; wallets holding more than 1000 Normies are refused.
Errors are JSON: {error, code, retryable}. Unknown /api and /.well-known paths also answer JSON 404.

Human UI:
/  /ask  /paths  /burn  /dashboard

Do not ask for keys, seeds, signatures.
